name: Laguna Phuket Marathon 2027
short_description: The Laguna Phuket Marathon 2027 takes place on June 12, 2027, in Ban Bang Thao, Phuket, Thailand, offering five race distances.
ai_summary: The Laguna Phuket Marathon 2027 is scheduled for June 12, 2027, at Laguna Phuket in Ban Bang Thao, Phuket, Thailand. The event offers five distance options: a full marathon (42.195km), half marathon (21.098km), 10km, 5km, and 2km, catering to a range of runners from elite marathoners to casual participants. Priority registration is currently open for those who finished the 2026 edition, giving returning runners an early opportunity to secure their spot in this Thailand-based race.
